The '''Capital City''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]] was the seat of the planet's government. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] under the command of [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]] [[Quorl Matrin]]. Following the Empire's defeat at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barpotomous Drebble/Legends|Barpotomous Drebble]] was able to take control of a substantial portion of the capital, after gaining the loyalty of a large number of the local population. With his connection to the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], Drebble ruled his section of the capital in the best interests of the Alliance.
